description: Probe a site for publicly exposed sensitive files attackers scan for: /.env and variants, /.git/config and /.git/HEAD, /.svn/entries, docker-compose files, /.aws/credentials, /.ssh/id_rsa, database dumps (backup.sql, db.sql, dump.sql), backup archives, phpinfo pages, .DS_Store, and similar. Reports ONLY reachability metadata (path, status, content type, size) — file contents are never returned or stored. A random-nonexistent-path baseline filters out SPA/catch-all false positives. For auditing your own sites' exposure.

url.description: Any URL on the site to probe (origin is derived from it)

name: exposed_files_check
